---
title: "Cost Calculator"
---

Interactive tool for estimating uSort-M experiment costs.

## Calculator

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| panel: input

viewof libSize = Inputs.range([50, 5000], {
  value: 500, 
  step: 50, 
  label: "Library size (variants)"
})

viewof seqLen = Inputs.range([100, 1500], {
  value: 300, 
  step: 50, 
  label: "Sequence length (bp)"
})

viewof foldSamp = Inputs.range([2, 20], {
  value: 8, 
  step: 1, 
  label: "Fold sampling"
})

viewof skewVal = Inputs.range([1, 20], {
  value: 4, 
  step: 0.5, 
  label: "Library skew (Q90/Q10)"
})
```

### FACS Rates

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| panel: input

viewof machineRate = Inputs.range([0, 150], {
  value: 70, 
  step: 5, 
  label: "Machine rate ($/hr)"
})

viewof operatorRate = Inputs.range([0, 150], {
  value: 65, 
  step: 5, 
  label: "Operator rate ($/hr)"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Twist pricing
twistPricing = [
  {min: 2, max: 100, prices: {120: 400, 150: 466, 200: 520, 250: 689, 300: 1030, 350: 1288}},
  {min: 101, max: 500, prices: {120: 800, 150: 933, 200: 1040, 250: 1379, 300: 2060, 350: 2575}},
  {min: 501, max: 1000, prices: {120: 1200, 150: 1400, 200: 1560, 250: 2068, 300: 3090, 350: 3863}},
  {min: 1001, max: 2000, prices: {120: 1600, 150: 1867, 200: 2080, 250: 2757, 300: 4121, 350: 5152}},
  {min: 2001, max: 6000, prices: {120: 2400, 150: 2800, 200: 3120, 250: 4136, 300: 6181, 350: 7727}},
]

function getTwistCost(nSeqs, seqLength) {
  const tier = twistPricing.find(t => nSeqs >= t.min && nSeqs <= t.max) || twistPricing[twistPricing.length - 1];
  const lengths = [120, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350];
  let bracket = lengths.find(l => seqLength <= l) || 350;
  if (seqLength > 350) {
    return nSeqs * seqLength * 0.09;  // Instance pricing
  }
  return tier.prices[bracket];
}

// Calculations
synthCost = getTwistCost(libSize, seqLen)
cloneCost = 53.60
wells = Math.round(libSize * foldSamp)
plates = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wells / 384))
sortMins = plates * 8 + 30
sortCost = (sortMins / 60) * (machineRate + operatorRate)
barcodeCost = plates * 97.73
seqCost = 500 + (wells > 20000 ? 50 : 0)
pickCost = libSize * 0.128 + Math.ceil(libSize / 384) * 7.84

totalCost = synthCost + cloneCost + sortCost + barcodeCost + seqCost + pickCost

// Traditional
tradSynth = libSize * 35
tradClone = libSize * (2680/250 + 165/(6*200) * 10)
tradSeq = 500
tradTotal = tradSynth + tradClone + tradSeq

savingsFactor = tradTotal / totalCost
```

## Effort Estimates

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

sortHrs = sortMins / 60
barcodeHrs = plates * 2
sortDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((sortHrs + 2) / 8))
barcodeDays = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(barcodeHrs / 8))
totalDays = 1 + sortDays + barcodeDays + 3  // assembly + sort + barcode + seq
```

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Total wells | ${wells.toLocaleString()} |
| 384-well plates | ${plates} |
| Sorting time | ${sortDays > 1 ? sortDays + " days (" + sortHrs.toFixed(1) + " hrs)" : sortHrs.toFixed(1) + " hours"} |
| Barcoding time | ${barcodeDays > 1 ? barcodeDays + " days (" + barcodeHrs + " hrs)" : barcodeHrs + " hours"} |
| **Total project time** | **~${totalDays} days** |

## Cost Breakdown Visualization

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

breakdownData = [
  {step: "Synthesis", usortm: synthCost, traditional: tradSynth},
  {step: "Cloning", usortm: cloneCost, traditional: tradClone},
  {step: "Sorting", usortm: sortCost, traditional: 0},
  {step: "Barcoding", usortm: barcodeCost, traditional: 0},
  {step: "Sequencing", usortm: seqCost, traditional: tradSeq},
  {step: "Hit-picking", usortm: pickCost, traditional: 0},
]

Plot.plot({
  height: 350,
  marginLeft: 100,
  marginRight: 80,
  x: {
    label: "Cost (USD)",
    grid: true,
    tickFormat: d => `$${d.toLocaleString()}`
  },
  y: {
    label: null,
    domain: breakdownData.map(d => d.step)
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(breakdownData, {
      y: "step",
      x: "usortm",
      fill: "#2563eb",
      title: d => `uSort-M: $${d.usortm.toLocaleString()}`
    }),
    Plot.barX(breakdownData.filter(d => d.traditional > 0), {
      y: "step",
      x: "traditional",
      fill: "#dc2626",
      fillOpacity: 0.5,
      title: d => `Traditional: $${d.traditional.toLocaleString()}`
    }),
    Plot.text(breakdownData, {
      y: "step",
      x: d => d.usortm,
      text: d => `$${d.usortm.toLocaleString(undefined, {maximumFractionDigits: 0})}`,
      dx: 5,
      textAnchor: "start",
      fill: "#2563eb"
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0])
  ]
})
```
